positions.assessment: The End Phase condition counts any LIGHT monster sent from hand or Deck to the GY this turn. The opponent's discard of LIGHT Blue-Eyes Alternative qualifies, and the engine offered the effect. Saffira's once-per-turn use is free here, and she can add SDQ back to hand or draw 2.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: The player misread the condition: it doesn't require the card to come from your own hand. Declining gives up free card advantage with no downside.

grades.label: B
grades.reason: The condition is met by the opponent's LIGHT Blue-Eyes Alternative going from hand to GY, so activating is free value.

positions.assessment: The opponent has no monsters, 4000 LP, and two face-downs. Saffira already hit for 2500 (Chronocorder's reflect didn't apply to me), and the second Saffira is attacking for 2500. Manju (1400) and Witch (100) can still attack, so the total is exactly 4000, which is lethal. Forbidden Lance has no opposing target and would only lower my own attacker's ATK. Passing is correct.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: Lance has no useful target and would hurt the attack; passing is correct. The reason doesn't see the lethal, but the move is right.

grades.label: B
grades.reason: It correctly sees the exact lethal of 2500+2500+1400+100 and keeps Lance off my own attackers.

positions.assessment: The opponent is at 2900 with an empty board and Blue-Eyes Alternative in hand, which destroys a monster and Special Summons from hand. Banishing the GY SDQ to Ritual Summon Sauravis from hand uses Djinn Demolisher and Honest as Tributes. Honest is LIGHT and goes from hand to GY, which should also enable Saffira's End Phase effect. Sauravis can then negate and banish their Special Summon. The hand SDQ discard is still available afterwards as a separate effect, from a separate copy. Pre-Preparation adds little, since Hymn is already in the GY and Saffira is plentiful.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: It builds a board answer to Blue-Eyes (Sauravis negating the Special Summon), spends mostly surplus cards, and likely triggers Saffira's End Phase via the Honest Tribute. It leaves the hand SDQ effect for afterwards.

grades.label: B
grades.reason: A fine first step that sets Hymn, adds Saffira and enables the End Phase effect. Done alone it doesn't give any defense against Blue-Eyes. It is best as a follow-up to the Sauravis play.

grades.label: C
grades.reason: It adds cards I don't need (Hymn is already in the GY, and I have SDQ) and doesn't answer Blue-Eyes. Its stated plan of saving Tribute fodder is slow, and it isn't a real threat or defense.
